name: Arco
source:
"I'm hungry."

An incredibly rare and valuable dragon, the only one of her kind in the galaxy.
She was born from a black hole so she's always hungry. Her normal form is that of a small dragon, but after she eats she changes into her human form. She promised to eat Marco when she's most delicious. She has a cavity.
